title: ISSELECTEDMEASURE is TRUE for the measure it names: the item multiplies [Total] by 10
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Total], Adjust[Adjustment] = "Only Total x10" ) )

source.quote: True whether the measure that is currently in context is one of those specified in the list of parameters.
source.supports: the measure in context is [Total], which the item names

derivation: The item is IF ( ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Total] ), SELECTEDMEASURE () * 10, SELECTEDMEASURE () ). For [Total]: 60 * 10 = 600.
